title: Book of Enoch excluded but holding truth, per Malachi Martin

tellings.quote: Catholic per Catholic teaching per Malachi Martin who was one of the per first people to read the Dead Sea Scrolls.

plain: Dylan Borland, a former serviceman who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text left out of most Bibles. He says that, according to Catholic teaching as explained by Malachi Martin, a Catholic writer he describes as one of the first people to read the Dead Sea Scrolls, the book was left out yet still holds truth. He raises it because it would tie old scripture to his account of beings beyond us.
